name: Bald
rootCause: Coinbase’s compliant and grown-up L2 is already a shitshow. BALD pulled the rug for $23M, and the deployer has some interesting connections... YOLO-mania is in full force while DeFi burns.

descriptions.text: Coinbase’s compliant and grown-up L2 is already a shitshow. BALD pulled the rug for $23M, and the deployer has some interesting connections... YOLO-mania is in full force while DeFi burns.

A MEME coin called BALD, built on the Coinbase Base test network, appears to have pulled in at least $25.6 million. Although the Base network was intended to be used for developer testing, an anonymous cryptocurrency user named "Bald" announced that they would be selling BALD tokens on the Base network, and the token's price skyrocketed. However, token deployers emptied liquidity pools of around $25.6 million worth of tokens just two days after launch, clearly pulling the market. The token price quickly plummeted by around 90%.

On 2 August 2023, the deployer of the BALD token on Base removed nearly all liquidity from its pools, draining over $23 million in ETH and causing a rapid collapse in the token's value. This event is widely classified as a liquidity rug pull. The deployer had unrestricted control over the liquidity pool contracts and used this authority to remove nearly all supplied ETH, executing a liquidity rug pull. No code vulnerability was exploited; rather, the incident relied on insufficient permission and public governance controls.
